That's fine. No amount of weightlifting can transform me into a 7-foot, 325-pound juggernaut.But when it comes to making money, I do everything in my power to imitate the big guy. He's an investing whiz. Not only did he make timely bets on Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL), Five Guys Enterprises LLC, 24 Hour Fitness, and more, but he invested in Google-now Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL)-before the IPO.That said, there's only so far I can follow. Shaq,.
